{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Fine-knit turtleneck, slim fit, hip length, camel (#C19A6B), merino wool
Straight-leg trousers, high waist, full length to the ankle, charcoal (#3B3F46), wool crepe with a soft lining
Double-breasted trench coat, belted, knee-length, deep navy (#1F2A44), water-repellent cotton gabardine with a removable warm lining
Ankle boots, almond toe, low block heel of 4 cm, black (#1A1A1A), waterproof smooth leather with a grip sole
Scarf, generous rectangle, soft grey-beige (#B8B2A7), lambswool, worn tucked inside the coat collar
Structured crossbody bag, medium size, black (#1A1A1A), grained leather
Compact umbrella with a strong wind-resistant frame, black (#1A1A1A), nylon canopy

Why this works: The camel knit with charcoal trousers and a navy trench is a classic, quiet palette that suits a cinema evening and carries easily into dinner afterwards. The merino knit, lined wool trousers and warm scarf keep her comfortable at +9 °C, while the belted water-repellent coat, waterproof boots and wind-resistant umbrella handle the downpour and the wind. Every piece is neat and tailored without being fussy, so the look stays restrained and polished in a dim cinema and a restaurant alike. The low block heel keeps the walk through wet streets steady and comfortable."}
